answers.how: Fitting the ball’s airborne trajectory gives gravity ≈8000 px/s², so the scale is 0.1225 cm/px. Its diameter is approximately 34.5 px.
Kettle height ≈129 px × gravity-derived scale of 0.1225 cm/px.
The kettle and plate centers are approximately 453 px apart; multiplying by 0.1225 cm/px gives their center-to-center distance.
The cylinder and plastic bottle centers are approximately 187 px apart; multiplying by 0.1225 cm/px gives their center-to-center distance.
A trajectory fit near 1.50 s gives velocity components approximately −590 and 500 px/s. Their magnitude is converted using 0.001225 m/px.
Positions at 2.40, 2.50 and 2.60 s give velocity components near 2.50 s of approximately −195 and −310 px/s. Their magnitude is converted using 0.001225 m/px.
